d: A tiny camera. An AI chatbot. A near-perfect exam score. South Korea's cheating scandal exposed a new threat to its education system. With the Suneung approaching, the government went into overdrive - inspecting students, surrendering phones and even sending emergency alerts to mobile devices nationwide. But the crisis didn't end at the exam hall. It reached the education minister, who resigned after his remarks triggered public outrage. Is South Korea prepared for the age of AI cheating?
